Controls the auditor will ask about

The Cyber & Zero-Trust control frame for Maritime, Ports & Shipping: SOLAS/ISPS (port security duties); Customs regimes (cargo documentation); Environmental (IMO/FEU) (emissions reporting). Controls are designed against these duties up front, identity, access, retention and explainability are architectural decisions here, not audit-season retrofits.
